A Note From The Author

This is the exact original book.
Nothing rewritten. Nothing softened.

My name is Nisuta Acharya. I wrote this book exactly as I lived it. Every word you read here is the exact original text from my private memoir. I did not rewrite it to make it sound better. I did not edit the memories to make them easier to read.

This digital platform was created only to improve the reading experience for screens. The original paper book is private and will always stay at home. But love stories deserve to be read properly — on your phone, on your tablet, on your laptop — without the strain of a scanned PDF or a small font. So I built this edition with clean type, full-screen pages, and careful spacing, without changing a single word of the story.

I wrote this memoir for our children and grandchildren, so they would know how hard Saugat and I fought to stay together. But this book is also for anyone outside our family who wants to read a true love story.

If you believe love is worth fighting for — when the world says let go, when distance says forget, when paperwork says impossible — then this book is for you. This is not a love story that was easy. This is a love that refused to let go.

Thank you for reading our story, exactly as it happened.

Nisuta Acharya — For Saugat ♥ Forever
